# How to Make the Most out of your Global Income


Gaelle Yammine


Jan 7, 2026


Every international payment loses money to fees and markups. Here's exactly how to receive payments from US, UK, European, and GCC clients while keeping more of what you earned.


#### ‍ What You're Losing Right Now


Traditional banks: 3-5% conversion + $25-45 per transaction


PayPal/Payoneer: 2-3% + poor exchange rates


Intermediary banks: $15-25 each (sometimes multiple)


Real cost: $2,000 payment/month = $60-140 lost


Annual damage: $720-1,680 gone in fees ‍


### ‍ If You’re Receiving from the United States:


Fee comparison:


❌ Bank SWIFT wire: $25-45 receiving fee + 2-3% markup


❌ PayPal: 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction


❌ Payoneer: 2-3% withdrawal fee


✅ nsave ACH: FREE receiving


#### How to Set it Up:


- Get nsave US routing number + account number
- Share with Upwork, Fiverr, Deel, or direct US clients
- Employers add you like any US direct deposit
- Receive: FREE | Send locally: low fees with Google rates


#### Platform optimization:


Upwork → Bank transfer to nsave ACH (free receiving vs $0.99-$2.99)


Fiverr → Bank withdrawal to nsave (free vs 3% PayPal fee)


Deel → ACH to nsave (free receiving)


Freelancer.com → Bank transfer to nsave (free receiving)

### If You’re Receiving from The GCC (UAE, KSA, Qatar, Kuwait, etc):


Fee comparison:


❌ Exchange houses: 2-5% markup + AED 50-100 fees


❌ Western Union/MoneyGram: 3-6% fees


❌ Traditional bank SWIFT: $25-45 + intermediaries


✅ nsave SWIFT: FREE receiving


How to Set it Up:


- Request USD payment from GCC employer/client (most can pay USD)
- Share nsave SWIFT details: BIC, account number, bank address
- Direct wire transfer - skip exchange houses entirely
- Receive: FREE | Send locally: low fees with Google rates


Platform Optimization: Dubai/UAE companies → USD wire to nsave (free receiving vs 2-5% exchange houses)


Saudi clients → USD or SAR wire (free receiving)


Qatar/Kuwait → USD wire for international contractors (free receiving)

#### Common Mistakes That Cost Money


- Using PayPal/Payoneer when direct bank transfer available (costs 2-3%)
- Not asking if clients can pay via bank/wire instead of platform
- Sending small amounts frequently instead of batching (multiple fees add up)
- Using GCC exchange houses instead of direct SWIFT (costs 2-5%)
- Not switching because "it's complicated" (takes 5 minutes, saves hundreds)
